Name: Super Forge
Author: po0pfart
Description:
Bring two weapons takes up space and switching rings is tedious. This mod lets you do the following: 

[list]
[*]Unlimited forging with gems (ruby, amethyst, jade, emerald, topaz and aquamarine), significantly boost weak weapons,
[*]Stacks enchantments on both weapons and tools, saving space and give better gameplay experience,
[*]Combines rings as many times as you want to assist you in any daily chores and combat,
[*]Configurable cinder shard cost to forge, enchant, and combine rings.
[/list]Check out my other mods!
